items.title: From Containers to Sandboxes: Developer Trust in the Agentic Era
items.summary: The 2026 Stack Overflow Developer Survey shows only 7% of developers trust AI output for important decisions. Here’s what that means for running agents safely.

items.title: AI Agent Security Risks: What Can Go Wrong When Agents Act on Their Own
items.summary: Learn the top AI agent security risks, from prompt injection to excessive autonomy and credential exposure, and how to contain them.

items.title: Harbor + Docker Sandboxes: Run Safe, Reproducible Agent Evals
items.summary: Harbor can now run every eval task in Docker Sandboxes Docker Sandboxes are MicroVM environments to run agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more safely With Sandboxes, define custom network policies for fair, reproducible evals Run your evals locally or in the cloud: starting for free on Docker Sandboxes on local surfaces and scaling...

items.title: Docker Hub security advisory: personal access tokens transferred during account-to-organization conversions
items.summary: CVE-2026-105445: Docker Hub account conversion could re-assign personal access tokens to a new owner. Read what happened, who was affected, and the fix.

items.title: Trust Docker for the agents you don’t
items.summary: At WeAreDevelopers, Docker introduced Cloud Sandboxes, the open Sandbox Kit specification, and a commitment to bring Kits to the CNCF for neutral governance.

items.title: Manufacturing Trust for AI Agents | Docker’s WeAreDevelopers Keynote
items.summary: Docker's WeAreDevelopers keynote shows how Sandboxes, Kits, and Cloud Sandboxes give AI agents strong isolation and reproducible authority.

items.title: From Dockerfile to Kit: the Docker Sandboxes Kit Specification
items.summary: Docker's Sandbox Kit Specification v3 packages an AI agent's network rules, credentials, and volumes as an ordinary, pinnable OCI image.

items.title: Docker and CNCF partner on an open spec for agent permissions
items.summary: Docker is bringing the open source Sandbox Kit Spec to the CNCF, so AI agent permissions become a neutral, vendor independent standard built on OCI.

items.title: Introducing Cloud Sandboxes: Start on Your Laptop, Finish in the Cloud
items.summary: Run agents on your laptop, in the cloud, and move between them with one command, all safely. Earlier this year we launched Docker Sandboxes: microVM environments where coding agents can work autonomously in a safe way.

items.title: Meet the Ecosystem: Partners and Customers at WeAreDevelopers with Docker
items.summary: Meet the partners and customers bringing practical AI, security, and development sessions to the Docker Pavilion at WeAreDevelopers. The post explains why a strong ecosystem matters to developers, announces the sessions and speakers, and invites attendees to connect with the teams building and using these technologies.
